{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA rows with revenue = 999999.99
qa_rows = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA rows:", len(qa_rows))
print("Sample of QA rows:", qa_rows[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'revenue', 'revenue_clean']].head())"}
